entries.name: POS_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder on the owner's machine or the instance's volume where point-of-sale CSV exports are dropped. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.
Export items, stock on hand, customers and sales from the POS as CSV into it. Each export can be a new file; a file that changes is read again.

entries.name: POS_MAPPING_PROFILE
entries.description: Which columns the POS exports use: generic, or the path to a mapping profile JSON kept in the client's private instance repo.
howToGet: Leave as generic when the exports use the column names in docs/integrations.md.
Otherwise write a profile for the client's POS in their private instance repo and put its path here.
